title: DATE Data Type
description: Learn how to use the DATE data type to store date values in SQL Server.

data.text: The DATE data type stores only the date component (no time). The range is from January 1, 1 CE to December 31, 9999 CE.
It takes 3 bytes to store a DATE value. The default literal string format is YYYY-MM-DD.

data.title: Query by DATE Value
data.code:
SELECT     
    order_id, 
    customer_id, 
    order_status, 
    order_date
FROM     
    sales.orders
WHERE order_date < '2016-01-05'
ORDER BY 
    order_date DESC;

data.title: DATE Columns in a Table
data.content: Creates a table with DATE columns for validity periods.
data.code:
CREATE TABLE sales.list_prices (
    product_id INT NOT NULL,
    valid_from DATE NOT NULL,
    valid_to DATE NOT NULL,
    amount DEC (10, 2) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (product_id, valid_from, valid_to),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) 
      REFERENCES production.products (product_id)
);

data.title: DATE Key Points
points: DATE stores only the date component (no time).
Use DATE when you only need to store dates, not times.
